ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Waste and Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid waste and fraud in Minnesota and nationwide, and explore the impact on taxpayers and healthcare recipients.
ideas.angle: Investigative reporting on government waste and fraud
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid waste and fraud in Minnesota?
How does this impact taxpayers and healthcare recipients?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant waste and fraud, and to hold government agencies accountable for their actions.
